versions.changelog:
Initial release — connect Hermes Agent to the Zed editor via the Agent Client Protocol (ACP).

- Provides a step-by-step guide for wiring Hermes as a Zed External Agent.
- Explains ACP setup, required prerequisites, and platform differences (native Linux vs. Flatpak).
- Details Zed/Hermes configuration boundaries and necessary settings changes.
- Offers troubleshooting tips and common pitfalls for ACP connectivity.
- Includes references for advanced setup and Flatpak JSONC editing.
